newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Telecel hits another high.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Telecel hits another high.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel hit an all-time high for the second consecutive day on Lisbon bourse amid optimism over its 1996 results, dealers said.

"A seven billion escudos profit for 1996 had been expected for Telecel, but after the excellent results of its main rival TMN, we think Telecel's profits could reach nine billion escudos or even exceed that level," said one dealer who asked not to be identified.
Telecel shares hit a high of 13,500 escudos in volume of 80,955 shares at 1050 GMT.
Telecel is due to present its 1996 results on February 12.
